name: Standard Scramble (Constance Pass / Home Lake)
summary: Both cards start at the Upper Dungeness Trailhead (Home Lake/Constance Pass vs Royal Basin/Deception divide). Same trailhead, two genuinely different tracks.

summary: Bridge Creek trailhead, down Bridge Creek and up the North Fork; single approach and correctly stored.

primary: Swamp Creek and the south ridge

name: South Slope

name: Standard Scramble
summary: North Fork Quinault trail to the Sixteen Mile ford; the 'Graves Creek' match is only a note distinguishing the other road.

name: Fremont Glacier

approaches.joins: Park Creek trail up to Park Creek Pass, joining the Thunder Creek line there

summary: Low Divide camp is reached from the North Fork Quinault (standard) or the Elwha; the prose names both but there are no per-trailhead cards.

summary: Paradise to Camp Muir, identical to the Disappointment Cleaver walk-in; FINISH flag is noise.

approaches.joins: Climbs the moraine above Van Trump Park and the remnant Van Trump Glacier, merging with the Paradise line around the Castle / base of the Turtle.

primary: Depot Creek from the Canadian side

name: Standard Scramble (Marmot Lake / Duckabush approach)

name: North Ridge (Complete)

approaches.name: North side up Mountaineer Creek
